newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS AND BAT FIRST AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS AND BAT FIRST AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: Natal captain Dale Benkenstein won the toss and chose to bat first in their one-day cricket match against India at Kingsmead on Monday.
Natal: Neil Johnson, Doug Watson, Errol Stewart, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Derek Crookes, Mark Bruyns, Keith Forde, Pat Symcox, Tertius Bosch, Gary Gilder.
India: Vikram Rathore, Woorkeri Raman, Rahul Dravid, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, V.V.S.Laxman, Pankaj Dharmani, Syed Saba Karim, David Johnson, Doda Ganesh, Venkatapathy Raju.
